news.title: Send us your Scotland World Cup memories of Boston
news.lede: Scotland played their first two World Cup group games in Boston. BBC Scotland is again looking for Scotland fans to send us in their footage, audio and pictures - this time capturing the memories from Boston during the World Cup. Thousands of Tartan Army supporters descended on the city and a relationship to last well beyond the World Cup was born. We are looking for Scotland fans to send us their videos, audio and memories of that magical week or so in Boston.

news.title: Two More African Nations Qualify for the Women's World Cup
news.lede: Two more African nations have qualified for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup following the conclusion of the play-in round in this year's Women's African Cup of Nations. The play-in round featured all four nations that were eliminated in the quarter-final stage of the tournament, including the defending African champions, Nigeria, who faced off against the 2022 winners, South Africa. Across the bracket, the Ivory Coast looked to secure their place in the World Cup as they took on Ghana. Here is how the play-in matches unfolded:.

news.title: Ajibade Apologises To Nigerians After Super Falcons Miss World Cup
news.lede: Super Falcons captain Rasheedat Ajibade has apologised to Nigerian football fans following the team’s failure to qualify for the FIFA Women’s World Cup, saying the players are determined to rebuild and return stronger. In a statement on X, Ajibade acknowledged the disappointment of missing the tournament for the first time…... In a statement on X, Ajibade acknowledged the disappointment of missing the tournament for the first time and said she personally took responsibility for the setback. There’s no way around that.

news.title: World Cup coach Graham Arnold returns to Baghdad - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq and the world
news.lede: Iraq football national team head coach Graham Arnold on Monday returned to Baghdad to finalize his contract extension and begin preparations for the Arabian Gulf Cup and 2027 AFC Asian Cup. The Australian had already accepted a deal running through February 20, 2027, with the possibility of a new agreement from March 1 covering Iraq’s 2030 World Cup qualifying campaign or finals participation. Arnold is expected to monitor Iraq Stars League matches as he assesses domestic players ahead of the 27th Arabian Gulf Cup in Jeddah from September 23 to October 6. Iraq are grouped with Saudi Arabia, Oman and Kuwait and will face the hosts in their final group match on September 29 before turning attention to the 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia.
